classes.label: Anything That Exists Fr
classes.description: The most general bucket. If it exists or can even be thought about, it goes here. Maximum scope.

classes.label: Lives Rent Free (Conceptual)
classes.description: Things that exist as ideas, relations, or structures rather than physical objects. No mass, full presence.

classes.label: Touchable IRL Thing
classes.description: Entities with an actual physical or causal presence in the world. You could stub your toe on these.

classes.label: Brain Resident
classes.description: Entities that live in or depend on mental processes. Constituted by cognition. Cannot be yeeted from existence by physical means.

classes.label: Actual Material Object
classes.description: Has mass, takes up space, exists in time. The kind of thing that existed before you thought about it.

classes.label: Checkable Take
classes.description: A statement that can be ratio'd by reality. Either true or false — no vibes-based middle ground.

classes.label: Idea Blob
classes.description: A mental representation grouping objects or properties under a shared vibe. Your brain's filing system.

classes.label: Manifesting It To Be True
classes.description: A mental state where you're holding a proposition as true. Receipts not required. Could be entirely cooked.

classes.label: Certified W (Backed Up)
classes.description: Justified true belief — the belief is backed, it's actually true, and the backing is legit. Gettier cases still haunt this definition though.

classes.label: The Connection Arc
classes.description: A link or association between two or more entities. How things relate to each other. The edges, not the nodes.

classes.label: Knowledge Link
classes.description: Relations specifically about how knowledge, justification, and evidence connect. The architecture of knowing.

classes.label: The Knower (Does Stuff)
classes.description: An entity capable of intentional action and forming beliefs. Has opinions. May or may not have receipts.

classes.label: Regular Person (Organic)
classes.description: A human knower. Biased, language-using, culturally embedded epistemic agent. Skill-issued at birth.

classes.label: AI Doing Its Thing
classes.description: A computational system with belief-like states and reasoning capacity. Architecture-pilled, training-data-coded.

classes.label: Where The Knowledge Came From
classes.description: The origin story of a justified belief. Could be reliable, could be cooked. The basis matters.
